title: Ravenwood Film Festival
summary: Festival key art and a retro B-movie poster for three nights of horror, sci-fi and thrillers in Sault Ste. Marie.
overview: Ravenwood is a genre film festival held at The Queen of Hearts Club in Sault Ste. Marie. We designed two looks for it: a brooding key art built around the festival's raven, and a loud, tongue-in-cheek poster that borrows from drive-in horror one-sheets to sell the weekend.

cover.alt: Ravenwood Film Festival key art: a raven's silhouette filled with misty pine forest, a strip of film leader and a glowing projector

challenge.heading: The brief
body: A new festival needs two things at once: an identity that feels like it has always been there, and promotion loud enough to fill a room for October 26–28.
One poster couldn't do both jobs, so we designed a system with two voices.

idea.heading: The idea
body: The key art is the festival's signature. A raven fades into a fog of Northern Ontario pines, with a film-leader countdown running through its wing and a projector throwing light out of the dark. It's the image for the website, the screen before every film and anything that needs to feel premium.

The event poster is the opposite: torn paper, a hand-drawn diner waitress with a vintage camera for a head and a tentacled monster under the cloche. Big yellow type, "Horror! Sci-fi! Thriller!" up top, and every practical detail — dates, venue, address and URL — easy to read from across the street.

execution.heading: What we delivered
body: Festival key art and wordmark lockup, a print poster with venue and date details, and matching assets for social and the festival website.
